name: Restaurant and partner onboarding
description: The platform must manage restaurant onboarding, menu information, order routing rules, and performance visibility for each partner.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about restaurant partners or onboarding.
Developer mentions menu or service rules.
Developer discusses partner performance or setup.

name: Order intake and dispatch workflow
description: The business needs a reliable order intake, assignment, and routing system so each order reaches the right driver and restaurant quickly.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how orders are received and assigned.
Developer mentions dispatch or driver assignment.
Developer discusses timing and order accuracy.

name: Driver management and accountability
description: The system must support driver profiles, availability tracking, delivery status, and performance monitoring for safe, accountable operations.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about drivers, availability, or delivery status.
Developer mentions accountability or performance tracking.
Developer discusses real-time delivery operations.

name: Delivery and ETA management
description: The business needs real-time delivery tracking, estimated times, and route coordination so service quality remains consistent.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about ETA or route management.
Developer mentions live delivery tracking.
Developer discusses timing or route optimization.

name: Payment, commissions, and reconciliation
description: The system must support customer payments, restaurant payouts, driver commissions, and reconciliation to avoid manual disputes.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about payment flows or payouts.
Developer mentions commissions or reconciliation.
Developer discusses fees or settlement.

name: Customer communication and support flow
description: The business needs order status updates, support handling, and issue resolution so delivery problems are visible and manageable.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about customer support, notifications, or issue management.
Developer mentions order updates or complaints.
Developer discusses customer communication in delivery operations.

name: Operations reporting and dashboards
description: The business needs reports on order volume, fulfillment speed, failed deliveries, and partner or driver performance to make operational decisions.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or operational metrics.
Developer mentions order volume, completion rates, or partner performance.
Developer discusses operational visibility for management.

name: Inventory and preparation coordination
description: The business must coordinate preparation timing between restaurants and the delivery workflow to avoid delays and food quality issues.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about food prep, stock, or cooking readiness.
Developer mentions kitchen preparation timing.
Developer discusses delays or order completion quality.

name: Operational constraints and integration realities
description: The solution must fit real-world conditions such as city coverage, payment integrations, existing booking tools, and the need for low friction during rush periods.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about existing tools or third-party systems.
Developer mentions training burden or downtime risk.
Developer discusses the realities of busy delivery periods and city coverage.
